How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
Most of our products are made to order, so lead times can vary depending on the item.
Popular items typically have a production lead time of 3 to 10 business days, while specialty handcrafted items can take 15 to 40 business days. Custom options, such as an added clearcoat finish, can also add 3 to 5 additional business days to the timeline.
Once production is finished and your order ships, transit usually takes 1 to 6 business days. You will receive an email with your tracking information as soon as your order leaves the warehouse or craftsman.
If you would like me to check the specific status of your order, please share your order number and email address!
